headline: Asian Stocks and Bitcoin Fall as Tech Selloff and Rising Oil Press Markets
summary: Asian stocks tumbled and bitcoin retreated below $82,000 as weak technology earnings and rising oil prices above $112 a barrel unsettled investors.
why: Broad market corrections driven by tech sector sentiment and commodity shocks impact global equity indices and risk assets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Risk-off sentiment driven by tech earnings and rising oil prices reduces demand for speculative crypto assets.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Weak earnings and AI-related growth concerns trigger a selloff in technology equities.

why_moved: Disappointing tech earnings combined with surging oil prices heightened macro inflation fears, driving a broad risk-off rotation out of equities and cryptocurrencies.
